name: SilphScope-Network
description: Send your current character to a shared file that lives outside any save, and by default also to a small server (optionally password-gated to a private pool) so other players can find it too -- turn on OFFLINE MODE to keep a save local-only. GHOST TYPE picks the flavor: PokeTrainer (a battle ghost with your party -- it spots you and forces a fight, or you can walk up and interact) or Friendly (no battle, just a talking NPC of yourself that can leave a visitor a one-time item from your bag). MODE hides overleveled PokeTrainer ghosts from low-level areas by default, scales them to your own level, or normalizes every ghost to one fixed level you pick. Now runs on Pokemon Gold (Beta) too, with its own sprite set and send-location rules. Test build.
